A refresh therefore shows the Surface cones with the top 440px of krylo2-feed.html (nav, ticker cards, hero headline) over them. Reported by the Founder on localhost 2026-10-08. 4) Dependencies: campaignfunnel.jsx left-nav highlight (skips the first navMode application so the landing view highlights nothing; verify still true). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none known. 6) Maps to current product model: yes. Classified Class A (wiring: the decided behavior exists on one path, not the initial state).
